title: Prompt Architect — LTX
footerNote: Fictional adults only · not affiliated with Lightricks
contentNote: All characters are fictional adults. No real people's likenesses.
subjectPlaceholder: The action in present tense, in the order it happens. Example: She sits on the edge of the bed, then turns her head to look back over her shoulder.
cameraPlaceholder: How the camera moves relative to the subject. Example: The camera holds a medium shot and slowly pushes in toward her shoulder.
audioPlaceholder: room tone, a sheet shifting, one soft breath
sequencePlaceholder: The action shared by every clip. Each shot is one continuous take with the character sheet repeated.

sequenceNotes.title: One take per clip
sequenceNotes.text: Each phase is its own prompt: one continuous shot, present tense, in time order.

sequenceNotes.title: Continuity
sequenceNotes.text: The same identity, setting, and lighting lines are inserted into every clip.

sequenceNotes.title: Length
sequenceNotes.text: Match how much you describe to the frame count. A short line will not fill a 10 second clip.

sequenceNotes.title: Audio
sequenceNotes.text: Turn on the audio line for LTX-2. It stays in the same paragraph.

principles.title: One shot
principles.text: Describe a single continuous take. Present tense, in the order things happen.

principles.title: Order
principles.text: Appearance, then action, camera movement, environment, lighting, and an optional audio line.

principles.title: Camera
principles.text: Say how the camera moves relative to the subject, not a shot list of cuts.

principles.title: Length
principles.text: 121 frames at 24 fps is about 5 seconds. Frame count must be 8×n+1.

principles.title: People
principles.text: Fictional adults only. Do not describe a real person's likeness.
